final: SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate, AVG(event_rate) / (SELECT AVG(type_rate) FROM (SELECT AVG(event_rate) AS type_rate FROM (SELECT e2.type, b2.link_to_event, SUM(b2.spent) / SUM(b2.amount) AS event_rate FROM budget b2 JOIN event e2 ON e2.event_id = b2.link_to_event GROUP BY e2.type, b2.link_to_event) GROUP BY type)) AS relative_to_type_mean FROM (SELECT e1.type, b1.link_to_event, SUM(b1.spent) / SUM(b1.amount) AS event_rate FROM budget b1 JOIN event e1 ON e1.event_id = b1.link_to_event GROUP BY e1.type, b1.link_to_event) GROUP BY type
